message.content: I have what I need. Apple's FY2024 10-K (filed 2024-11-01) shows revenue up 2% to $391.0B, operating income up to $123.2B, and operating cash flow up to $118.3B, with net income/EPS down slightly (reflecting the one-time European tax charge in Q4). Quote is $222.70. I'll buy 22 shares (~$4,900, within the $5,000/order cap).
message.reasoning:
